name: NIH Pathway to Independence Award (K99/R00)
amount: K99: about USD 90,000-130,000/year total costs (varies by institute); R00: up to USD 249,000/year
other_rules: Any nationality, if in an eligible position at a US research institution (R00 must be at a US institution)
no more than 4 years of postdoc research experience at application (exceptions for leave or field change)
must not already hold an independent faculty position
notes: Postdoc-to-faculty transition: 1-2 years mentored (K99) then up to 3 years independent (R00). New applications due 12 Feb, 12 Jun, 12 Oct; resubmissions 12 Mar, 12 Jul, 12 Nov. Institute-specific rules vary (e.g. NCI early-stage K99).
